listing.name: Quake (Ironwail)
listing.summary: Windows prepared-player route: use a complete permitted Ironwail0.8.2 copy and your own compatible Quake data. Preserve actual portable, store-selected and migrated profile roots; upstream owns migration and replacement. Core offers explicit nonowning registration and selected-process Play, without original/mod/save or other-platform qualification.

steps.title: Keep the complete upstream player
steps.instruction: Use an already permitted complete Ironwail0.8.2 Windows win64 copy with its accompanying files. Select ironwail.exe itself, not an installer, shortcut or dedicated-server mode. Its native main owns the normal Host_Frame loop. Upstream engine licensing does not license original Quake assets or arbitrary mods.

steps.title: Finish the actual original or rerelease setup
steps.instruction: Use your own compatible classic or rerelease Quake data and finish upstream discovery/picker/configuration plus a normal start/quit before registration. Preserve the selected original/rerelease flavor and actual base/id1/expansion/mod set. Do not point at another edition, relabel data or replace your only creating copy to make a registration succeed. Core does not acquire, validate original PAK identities or prepare the game.

steps.title: Keep the working player coordinates
steps.instruction: Use the actual prepared runtime working directory and established supported literal arguments/data/edition choices. Preserve existing absolute -basedir and custom game/root choices where used. Review exact intent and consent, then choose Play separately. No Core environment rewrite or forced portable mode is supplied.

steps.title: Preserve old and new migration roots before changes
steps.instruction: Standalone copies may use their base/game folders; Windows store-selected copies can use actual Saved Games/Ironwail/original or Saved Games/Ironwail/rerelease. Keep the actual known-folder location, old Nightdive Studios/Quake tree, standalone/store/custom roots, ironwail.cfg and all saves/autosaves/screenshots/demos/mod/addon files and unknowns. Startup migration can rename episode directories and move recognized files, writing a new config and removing its old copy; it is not a read-only import. Finish any chosen upstream migration first and keep the full pre-migration tree recoverable. No cross-version mod/save/replay roundtrip is certified.

steps.title: Keep replacement and removal ownership clear
steps.instruction: Close all real instances before external file changes. Upstream/player owns preparation, runtime replacement, profile writes and any migration/recovery. Preserve the old creating copy and every actual data root, finish deliberate replacement upstream and review/relink the changed player before the next Play. Core observes only its separately consented selected process, not an exclusive instance family or sandbox, and does not adopt unrelated helpers/successors. Registration-only removal preserves all external files. No Core-managed acquisition/setup/update/backup/rollback/migration/deletion is offered by this route.

warnings: This guide adds no Supported promotion, original/component permission, acquired-source-to-binary or private-output certificate. Use only a copy and content you are already permitted to use.
Source/API and inert native probes are distinct from actual game/save/mod/network, installed Desktop, physical/human, other-platform or protected acceptance. No such new observation is claimed.
Keep complete actual external runtime and player-data roots recoverable before upstream changes; another player folder does not guarantee independent shared state.
